- Transit: keys_mara, wallet_mara, phone_mara, jacket_mara, umbrella_mara, backpack_mara, lunchbox_mara. Zone: entry_table_e1, entry_hook_e1.

2. Time-Based Contexts:
- Morning (06:00-09:00): Transit dominates. Work items ready in bedroom/living. Care items persist on shelf.
- Day (09:00-17:00): Work dominates. Leisure items in living room.
- Evening (17:00-21:00): Leisure dominates. Work items in bedroom/desk.
- Night (21:00-06:00): Sleep dominates. Care items in bathroom.

3. Stability Rules:
- Objects remain in place when resident is absent (e.g., phone on nightstand, care items on shelf, keys on entry table).
- Shared kitchen items (mugs, bowls, plates) are stable in cupboard_k1/sink_k1/counter_k1.
- towel_rack_ba1 is exclusive to towel_mara.
- nightstand_b1 is exclusive to phone_mara.
- glasses_mara can appear in Living Room (coffee_table_l1) during morning, not just Sleep/Care zones.
- backpack_mara and yoga_mat_mara can appear in Leisure Zone (couch_l1) during morning.
- wallet_mara is often ON_PERSON during active kitchen use, but on entry_table_e1 when resident is out.
